title: CyberKitty 2077 / Phase 2
cost_scope: Quotes for saved image receipts only, including historical versions. Pending/submitted jobs without saved outputs are excluded. This is not a verified billing balance.
existing_dog_sheet_note: Fetch and Muzzle have usable source multiview sheets, so this Phase 2 gallery does not duplicate them.
dog_group_policy: Expanded library: Barkington plus seven other named dogs. This does not select which four are his initial cronies. Exactly five cat heroes remain fixed.
provider_policy: Higgsfield: still images only. Speech: the user’s ElevenLabs account only. No Higgsfield audio or video.
